name: Temporary WP-MVP-0004 post-F001 EOSV

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosv/wp-mvp-0004-post-f001
    paths:
      - .eos/wp-mvp-0004-post-f001-eosv-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact verification branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Revalidate merged correction and capture EOSV evidence
        shell: bash
        env:
          EOS_ACTOR: github-actions[bot]
          EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD: e5ae99e4856ddd69b1718839e5f201ff6440ffa5
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" HEAD

          rm .github/workflows/temporary-wp-mvp-0004-post-f001-eosv.yml
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-post-f001-eosv-trigger
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" -- crates engineering .eos machine | grep -v '^$')"

          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features

          grep -q '^WP-MVP-0004.*IN_REVIEW' .eos/work-packets.tsv
          grep -q '^\*\*Decision:\*\* REJECTED$' engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0004-REVIEW.md
          grep -q 'pub const MARKDOWN_PARSER_VERSION: &str = "2";' crates/monad-core/src/markdown.rs

          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              .eos/*|engineering/evidence/*|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope post-merge EOSV path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "chore(eosv): verify WP-MVP-0004 front-matter correction"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

metadata.title: Temporary Wp Mvp 0004 Post F001 Eosv
